features.description: Animation Effect to use for the LEDs
Calculated by using a hue color circle(value/255*360) If color = 255 display white max value is 255
Brightness of the LEDs max value is 100

1-60 is in seconds calculated 61-120 is in minutes calculated by(value-60) Example a value of 65 would be 65-60 = 5 minutes - 120-254 Is in hours calculated by(value-120) Example a value of 132 would be 132-120 would be 12 hours. - 255 Indefinitely max value is 255

exposes.name: NotificationComplete
exposes.description: Indication that a specific notification has completed..

exposes.name: DimmingSpeedUpRemote
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light dims up when controlled from the hub. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately on. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 25 (2.5s).

exposes.name: DimmingSpeedUpLocal
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light dims up when controlled at the switch. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately on. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with dimmingSpeedUpRemote setting..

exposes.name: RampRateOffToOnRemote
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light turns on when controlled from the hub. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately on. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with dimmingSpeedUpRemote setting..

exposes.name: RampRateOffToOnLocal
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light turns on when controlled at the switch. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately on. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with dimmingSpeedUpRemote setting..

exposes.name: DimmingSpeedDownRemote
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light dims down when controlled from the hub. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately off. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with dimmingSpeedUpRemote setting..

exposes.name: DimmingSpeedDownLocal
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light dims down when controlled at the switch. A setting of 0 turns the light immediately off. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with dimmingSpeedUpLocal setting..

exposes.name: RampRateOnToOffRemote
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light turns off when controlled from the hub. A setting of 'instant' turns the light immediately off. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with rampRateOffToOnRemote setting..

exposes.name: RampRateOnToOffLocal
exposes.description: This changes the speed that the light turns off when controlled at the switch. A setting of 'instant' turns the light immediately off. Increasing the value slows down the transition speed. Every number represents 100ms. Default = 127 - Keep in sync with rampRateOffToOnLocal setting..

exposes.name: InvertSwitch
exposes.description: Inverts the orientation of the switch. Useful when the switch is installed upside down. Essentially up becomes down and down becomes up..

exposes.name: AutoTimerOff
exposes.description: Automatically turns the switch off after this many seconds. When the switch is turned on a timer is started. When the timer expires, the switch is turned off. 0 = Auto off is disabled..

exposes.name: DefaultLevelLocal
exposes.description: Default level for the load when it is turned on at the switch. A setting of 255 means that the switch will return to the level that it was on before it was turned off..

exposes.name: DefaultLevelRemote
exposes.description: Default level for the load when it is turned on from the hub. A setting of 255 means that the switch will return to the level that it was on before it was turned off..

exposes.name: StateAfterPowerRestored
exposes.description: The state the switch should return to when power is restored after power failure. 0 = off, 1-254 = level, 255 = previous..

exposes.name: LoadLevelIndicatorTimeout
exposes.description: Shows the level that the load is at for x number of seconds after the load is adjusted and then returns to the Default LED state. 0 = Stay Off, 1-10 = seconds, 11 = Stay On..
